author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Figure-eight hank along the diagonal: each loop now shows rope thickness (outer outline plus a teardrop eye), with a waist at the central wrap band. Reads as a coiled rope rather than an egg at 48 in both themes. The loop tips are squarish where they meet the SQUARE corners, and the eyes are small (hole passes the gate).
omissions: Three wrap turns reduced to one band; the neck has no room for more turns 8 apart.
